The logic followed here is:

Logic: Number of side of the figure = number.

For, [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89067eb2670fa44d8192f962e3a2503f4714ca5d949ff08b73c147f85c7f7abc.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9e27b9a0d36bd440e5648967275cd7fececb23819b7c23c14d68906f43cc3fe.png] has 3 sides = 3.

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f927fbf62ed8337c939751263b980065b84cac04cc0814c54dc797a17980cc32.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc52794b68839faf1521c19e30e1f9a707e4955cea389e076dce8706e5a8c66d.png] has 5 sides = 5.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
